main_body: A fenced farm plot: a wooden post-and-rail fence enclosing a field of crop rows (wheat, sprouts, cabbages, seedlings). The fence is the frame, the field is flat ground.
top_band: Fence rails read as lighter tan bands (rows 0-3 and 10-12) in the column scan, only 2 rows tall. The field interior is flat ground seen from above with no front face. No distinct top band and front face are drawn as a standing volume.
evidence: The drawing is a top-down plan of a fenced garden plot. The crop field is drawn as a flat map view, and the fence on all four sides is a flat ring with no standing front face. The side fence posts are drawn as vertical strips and the rails as 2-row bands, which reads as elevation or plan, not 3/4. The frame's horizontal beams show only thin 2px light edges over dark undersides, so they are rim-only. There is no front face for the whole object, and the field has no volume, so it fails the 3/4 contract.

style.evidence: The outlines are dark brown beside wood and dark green beside leaves, so they are tinted, with 0% neutral edge pixels. The crops carry good texture (wheat speckle, cabbage shading, sprout tufts) with 0% flat fill, and the wood shows about 4 steps. But the candidate has only 6 colours per tile against 17 and 20 for the references, and 27 distinct colours against 38 and 40. The fence rails and posts are simple and repetitive, and the grey checker background is flat and sparse. Overall it is noticeably thinner than the references in information density.
